recovery.title: Settings are temporarily read-only
recovery.message: Sparo OS continued startup with safe defaults because the saved configuration could not be loaded safely.
recovery.description: Rebuild the current defaults when you are ready. This deletes the unusable configuration and its saved secrets, but keeps sessions, workspaces, apps, and other data.
recovery.promptMessage: Sparo OS is running with safe defaults. Rebuild the current default configuration now? The unusable configuration and its saved secrets will be deleted; all other application data stays intact.
recovery.failed: The default configuration could not be rebuilt. Sparo OS is still running safely in read-only mode; try again from Settings.
